are_you_ok.title: Denver has coolest morning in 50 days, ties record low
questions: Did you get a break from the heat?
Is the wildfire smoke affecting you?
are_you_ok.description: Denver ties a record low temperature of 48 degrees, last seen in 1978, amidst a short-lived cool spell. Air quality suffers from wildfire smoke, prompting alerts.

you_should_know.title: Small town of Lochbuie approves 5-year moratorium on data centers, longest pause in Colorado
you_should_know.summary: In Lochbuie, a small town on the plains northeast of Denver about 30 miles east of Boulder, the lone councilmember to vote against the measure said the five-year timeframe was too long.

you_should_know.title: Jury unlikely to learn officer charged in man's killing had his credibility questioned by judge
you_should_know.description: Matthew Neeley was accused of second-degree murder in the 2025 fatal shooting Rajon Belt-Stubblefield, 37, after a traffic stop.
